answer: Reaching the opal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the shale of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the saffron re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
